title: Price Volatility Analysis
scenario: For each product, identify the difference between its maximum and minimum price across all recorded years. Return 'product_id' and 'price_diff'.
tableSchema: sales (sale_id INT, product_id INT, year INT, quantity INT, price INT)
hint: Group by product_id and calculate MAX(price) - MIN(price).
correctQuery: SELECT product_id, MAX(price) - MIN(price) AS price_diff FROM sales GROUP BY product_id;
setupSQL: CREATE TABLE sales (sale_id INT, product_id INT, year INT, quantity INT, price INT); INSERT INTO sales VALUES (1, 100, 2008, 10, 5000), (2, 100, 2009, 10, 7000);
